svg.title: Jones (2010) Physarum agents on a trail grid
svg.desc: Trail concentration after 25, 120 and 500 steps with six food flakes of different CPU weights and a weak corridor between C and D.
svg.text: Jones agent model, 4200 agents, 128 x 128 grid
SA 22.5, RA 45, SO 9, SS 1, deposit 5, decay 0.1, 3 x 3 mean; flake label = CPU percent; the corridor C-D is laid at 0.25 x 0.55 peak.
